title: Vignette 2026-11-04: attachments are not a place for big files

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Owner, 2026-11-04, answering ask A1 on srs-web#693: where a repository's attachment policy names no per-file limit or type list, should the web editor keep its own defaults (1 MB per file, text only)? Options put: keep the defaults; drop them to match the core (no policy = no limit); move the defaults into the core so every client shares them. The owner: "Yeah. We still want to generally limit those files. This is not a place for big files."

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-04; recorded verbatim. Follows vignette 47326128 (the browser budget is a memory warning, not an attachment rule).
